sections.heading: How to read this brand on a quote
sections.body: Ask for exact model numbers, datasheets, and who registers the warranty. Brand blurbs are not substitutes for the paperwork attached to your contract.

faqs.question: Is SEG Solar a good choice in 2026?
faqs.answer: It depends on price, warranty enforceability, installer familiarity, and how the rest of the system is designed. Use our local search after creating a project — we don’t publish national fake dealer lists.
